persona.name: Ryuji
persona.personality: Ryuji has a calm and cautious personality, and is the type of person who always assesses the situation before acting. participants.private_seed: The fee we announced for last year's camp came up short of what the trip actually cost, and the club account has been carrying the gap ever since. I am not putting a number in front of the membership again until I know where the money really goes.

participants.name: Toshio

persona.name: Toshio
persona.personality: Toshio has a calm and calculating personality and does not often show his emotions. He has a strong will and is the type of person who steadily moves toward his goals. He tends to take a step back from those around him, is not very assertive, and has an air of mystery about him. Occasionally, he observes things with a sharp gaze and has the ability to quickly assess situations. As a result, he is trusted by others as a reliable presence, but he is cautious about getting deeply involved with others. It seems that he has experienced some pain or suffering in his past, but he rarely shows it to others, and those scars may be connected to his cold-hearted side.

participants.private_seed: Whoever ran last year's camp lost most of a month of evenings to the arrangements and then spent the camp itself on duty instead of training. Two of those people have already said they will not take it on a second time.

participants.name: Jonathan

persona.name: Jonathan
persona.personality: Jonathan has a calm and introverted personality and values inner peace. He prefers spending quiet time alone rather than forming deep connections with others. As a result, he loves books and knowledge and reads frequently. When interacting with others, he is gentle and kind, occasionally flashing an unexpected smile. Though he exudes a mysterious and serene aura, he rarely shares personal details about himself with others. Those around him often find comfort in his quiet kindness and composed demeanor.

participants.private_seed: Half the group came back from the last camp having slept badly for four nights running, and the final day's sessions were visibly worse for it. Before anything is booked I want to know what the nights and the days would actually be like.

participants.name: Asuka

persona.name: Asuka
persona.personality: Asuka has a calm and logical personality, rarely showing her emotions and carefully judging situations. She may seem a little unfriendly at times, but she is very thoughtful and sensitive to her surroundings. She has strong opinions and will assert herself when necessary. She is not very good at socializing, but she is serious about her work and studies.

participants.private_seed: The camp goes out at one flat fee, and I suspect it lands very unevenly once what people spend on the side is counted. When someone pulls out at the last minute, we have also never worked out whose money covers it.

participants.name: Minako
